cancellation_reason: I need CSV downloads.
The subscription costs too much for our small team.
I need a CSV report emailed to my team automatically every Monday. Manual downloads do not work for us.
I canceled because I cannot download my reports as CSV files. I need to open them in Excel.

We needed cryptographic verification of webhook bodies before processing events.
